messages:
sam: anyone else hit a weird thing with redwoodctl after brew upgrade? my `local-test` starts but auth keeps redirecting to a random localhost port and the runtime rejects callbacks.
mai: which brew formula and which macOS?
sam: redwoodctl 0.14.2 from homebrew, macOS 13.6. command: `redwoodctl local-test start --config ./dev/rt.yaml` then in another terminal `redwoodctl login --device`. browser opens and callback shows 404 from the runtime: `GET /auth/callback?code=... 404`.
ops-bot: noticed similar reports in telemetry: auth-callback-404 during concurrent local-test + device auth flows (count=7 last 24h).
ed: probable cause: local-test binds to a host-port mapping (0.0.0.0:0) then prints a listening port to stdout, whereas the auth helper expects 127.0.0.1:8989 by default. if the runtime advertises a different host (e.g., 0.0.0.0) the auth helper constructs the redirect to host:port that the browser hits but the runtime sees the Host header mismatch and returns 404.
mai: can you paste the runtime startup log?
sam: here's the line: `INFO bound to 0.0.0.0:45213; public-url http://localhost:45213` and auth helper says `listening on http://127.0.0.1:45213`
ed: aha — mismatch between bound address and callback host. `http.Server` mux in runtime rejects requests where Host header doesn't match configured public-url (we added that check for virtual hosts). when auth helper uses 127.0.0.1 the Host is `127.0.0.1:45213` while public-url is `localhost:45213` -> 404.
mai: quick workaround: set `REDWOOD_PUBLIC_HOST=127.0.0.1` so runtime accepts that Host, or start local-test with `--public-host localhost` to force consistent urls.
sam: confirmed `REDWOOD_PUBLIC_HOST=127.0.0.1 redwoodctl local-test start` makes the callback succeed. thanks.
cli-bot: opened issue #6145 "local-test + auth helper: host mismatch causes callback 404" and PR draft in repo: github.com/redwood-inference/redwoodctl/pull/6146. Proposed fixes: (1) normalize public-url generation to prefer loopback host used by helper, (2) accept both `localhost` and `127.0.0.1` in Host check for local bindings, (3) log the actual Host header on mismatch to aid debugging.
ed: also add a small CLI warning if public-url and helper-host differ: "Detected loopback host mismatch between runtime and auth helper; set REDWOOD_PUBLIC_HOST to 127.0.0.1 or start with --public-host to avoid callback 404s."
mai: can we also surface this in the quickstart doc? many devs run into it when they have /etc/hosts entries mapping localhost to something unusual.
sam: yep please. i spent an hour chasing this thinking it was a browser extension.
ops-bot: triage tag: devexperience, priority: P2, assigned: ed.
sam: appreciated. small victory: raised the issue in our repo and left a short note in the onboarding checklist so new hires won't trip on it. :sparkles:
